correctness.rationale: The fixed-radius Bowen complexity equals finite-prefix complexity; the universal implication \(D_p>0\implies D_{p+1}=1\) follows by taking one additional logarithm. The disjoint finite-support block construction is compact with one accumulation point. Prefix bounds sandwich iterated-log asymptotics along a subsequence; the explicit control functions yield all values including a=1 and preceding 0. Finite checker confirms sample prefix inequalities, but infinite proof rests on exact estimates.

value.rationale: This is a complete spectrum theorem for a natural infinite family of dynamical covering invariants. It identifies compatibility across scales and realizes every allowed profile in a very restrictive topological class, including boundary cases not ensured by general one-scale lowerability. It is not an arbitrary finite or numerical example.
